notes:
Summary: evaluating Hosted API first (proof of concept in Feb), now moving toward Dedicated POC. Wants predictable latency and cost for product-search/rerank + customer support agent.

Recent timeline:
- 2026-02-20: Hosted API demo (Maya, David). Ran sample rerank flows against live dataset; product team liked quality. (fireflies ff_2026-02-20_hosted-api-demo-7741)
- 2026-03-02: Deep-dive on Dedicated economics and deployment options. Discussed reserved GPU pools and burst. (ff_2026-03-02_onyx-demo-9862)
- 2026-03-05: Security sync with Onyx security lead — SAML questions + encryption-at-rest. Jira REFD-4051 created for KMS integration checklist.

Use-case & targets (from product leads):
- Primary: reranking for product search (real-time). Secondary: agent summarization for support (multi-turn chat).
- Latency targets: p95 < 120ms for rerank API; chat p95 < 300ms acceptable for medium sessions.
- Throughput: average 25-40 req/s, spiky up to 120 req/s during releases.
- Cost sensitivity: medium — want clear unit economics and committed discount for Dedicated.

Model & routing preferences discussed:
- Prefer quantized open-model variants (7-13B int8) on Dedicated with Redwood-curated kernels.
- Canary plan: start with small model variant (rwft-7b-int8) at 5% traffic for 48 hours; metrics: latency, token cost, top-1 rerank accuracy, error rate. If metrics stable, move to 25% then 100% over week.
- Fallbacks: automatic route to hosted small model (hosted-fallback-3b) if Dedicated capacity constrained OR latency >200ms for >5% of requests in 10m window.
- Region failover: primary us-east-1 (low-latency to their infra), secondary eu-west-1 for regional DR; config to preserve model variant compatibility.
- Rollback policy: auto rollback to previous stable model if user-perceived quality regression detected (predefined eval set) or error spike >2% for 15m. Manual rollback option via console for SE/CSM.

Security & compliance notes:
- Requires SSO (SAML) + SCIM provisioning for dev and prod teams.
- Data residency preference: customer logs retained in NA region, evaluation logs masked. KMS for key management.

Pricing & commercial:
- Interested in committed Dedicated pool for predictable cost; asked for 12‑month commit example and burst pricing. Wants clear cost per 1M tokens with and without caching.
- Key ask: show unit economics with prefix caching and batching enabled using Redwood Optimize recommendations.

Quotes / paraphrases from stakeholders:
- "If we can keep rerank p95 under 120ms and cut cost per query by 30% vs our current provider, this is a go." — Head of Product
- "Need legal + security signoff before we touch prod data in a Dedicated environment." — Security Lead

Open action items / next steps:
- SE (David) to share Dedicated POC config template and canary policy doc by 2026-03-10.
- Schedule infra onboarding call week of 2026-03-15 (Redwood infra + Onyx cloud infra).
- Legal to receive DPA and example contract (Maya to follow up).
- Build eval prompt set (rerank QA set) for automatic quality gating — Onyx to deliver subset by 2026-03-12.

Short-hand CRM notes (recent calls/emails):
- "demo looked good; need numbers for committed pool" — follow up pricing email sent 2026-03-03.
- Security asked for sample SOC2 artifact; sent link (drive:/security/onyx/security-faq-2026).
- POC ask: 4-week Dedicated POC, canary routing, region failover test, SSO smoke test.

Potential blockers: legal DPA negotiation timeline, SAML integration windows, exec approval for ARR commit.

Files / refs: drive:/deals/onyx/POC-pricing-v2 (pricing scenarios), ff_2026-03-02_onyx-demo-9862 (call transcript).

Sales notes: mid-market ARR target $50k-$200k; strong chance if POC proves latency/cost claims. Recommended: prioritize SE-run canary + observability dashboard pre-wired.
